refused_transformations: U+2010, U+2011, U+2013 and U+002D stay distinct. Folding them would make a homoglyph substitution unlocatable BY THE GATE THAT EXISTS TO CATCH IT
an identifier's case is part of it; folding would make two different cell references one unit
U+2018/U+2019 and U+201C/U+201D stay distinct from U+0027 and U+0022 for the same reason as the dashes

transformations: U+00AD is a line-break hint inserted by a typesetter, never a character of the instrument; leaving it in makes a quote fail to locate for a reason no reader can see
Unicode NFKC. Expands the ligatures a PDF text layer emits (U+FB01 -> 'fi') and folds compatibility forms, so two extractions that differ only in encoding agree
every run of Unicode whitespace becomes one U+0020 and the ends are stripped; column and line geometry is a property of the rendering, not of the text
